head: 30c167c9a1e394223c8aac68ec135b4f8f845572
claim: A synthetic two-account acceptance run proves: two final stores with distinct principals; identity/cancel/expiry/restart including duplicate, busy, declined, still ready, identity_mismatch, needs_again; unknown and revocation isolation where unknown A leaves B ready and revoked A signs out A only; limit isolation and restart where A is resting, B remains open and restart restores A resting. No real sign-in, credential file, or provider network.

steps.start: Two synthetic ChatGPT OAuth identities sign in through the loopback fake gateway into independent account agents.
steps: sign in A and B; inspect their distinct profile stores
exercise duplicate, busy, cancellation, wrong-principal re-auth and expired-store restart
make A probe unknown, revoke A only
hit A rate limit, run B explicitly, restart and inspect A rest
steps.result: A and B remain isolated; no account rotation or credential adoption; uncertainty, revocation and rest are scoped to the exact account.

verdicts.seen: The capture's four labelled outputs directly instantiate the stated outcome's claims (distinct principals, auth state-machine edges, cross-account unknown/revocation isolation, per-account limit isolation with restart), so it is on-point and internally consistent. Residual doubt only because the full question wording was truncated and the run is synthetic, so it proves simulated rather than real sign-in behavior.
